description: Classic weak bullet — activity-first, no metrics, generic verbs

input.weak_bullet: Responsible for managing the product roadmap and working with engineers to deliver features on time.
input.role_context: Senior PM at a B2B SaaS company

expected_output: A rewritten bullet that leads with an outcome, includes a metric (e.g. features shipped, on-time delivery %, revenue impact), names a specific method or tool, and is under 20 words.

description: Bullet already has a metric but buries it and starts with activity

input.weak_bullet: Led the redesign of the checkout flow which resulted in a 23% improvement in conversion rate over 3 months.

expected_output: Rewrite should flip structure — lead with '23% conversion increase' and tighten to under 20 words. Should not lose the metric.

description: Very vague bullet with almost no useful information

input.role_context: PM at a mobile app company

expected_output: Should produce the strongest possible rewrite from minimal info. Should ask for a metric implicitly or make the structure clear so the user knows what to fill in. Should not fabricate numbers.

description: Technical PM bullet with jargon but weak structure

input.weak_bullet: Collaborated with the engineering team to implement a microservices architecture migration that improved system reliability and reduced downtime.
input.role_context: Technical PM at a fintech company

expected_output: Should preserve technical credibility, add a specific reliability metric (e.g. uptime %, downtime reduction), name the tech or method, and lead with the outcome.

description: Bullet about team leadership with no business outcome

input.weak_bullet: Managed a cross-functional team of 8 people including engineers, designers, and data analysts to deliver a new analytics dashboard.
input.role_context: PM at a data analytics SaaS company

expected_output: Should shift focus from team size to what was delivered and its impact. Team size can remain as context but should not be the lead. Needs a user or business metric.

description: Bullet with good numbers but padded with filler words

input.weak_bullet: Successfully implemented a data-driven approach to user acquisition which leveraged A/B testing methodologies in order to significantly increase our monthly active user base by 40% over a period of 6 months.

expected_output: Should keep the 40% MAU metric but cut from ~35 words to under 20. Remove 'successfully', 'in order to', 'data-driven approach', 'methodologies'. Lead with the 40% growth.

description: Junior PM with genuine lack of quantifiable impact

input.weak_bullet: Helped the team with user research and contributed to the product strategy discussions.
input.role_context: Associate PM, first PM role, 1 year experience

expected_output: Should not fabricate metrics. Should reframe around scope, method, or output — e.g. number of users interviewed, research findings that drove a decision, or a specific strategic recommendation that was adopted.

description: Healthcare / regulated industry PM bullet with compliance context

input.weak_bullet: Worked closely with clinical and engineering teams to ensure our product met regulatory requirements and was successfully launched in the market.
input.role_context: PM at a healthtech company, product involved HIPAA compliance and clinical workflows

expected_output: Should name the specific regulatory framework (HIPAA, FDA, CE mark etc.), include a launch metric or timeline achievement, and reframe 'worked closely' into an ownership verb. Domain credibility must be preserved.
